source: GDSC Combinations anchor screen (Jaaks et al., Nature 2022, doi:10.1038/s41586-022-04437-2), processed files {breast,colon,pancreas}_anchor_combo.csv.gz from https://gdsc-combinations.depmap.sanger.ac.uk/downloads

definitions.design: 2 anchor concentrations x 7-point library dose response; each row = cell line x anchor x anchor conc x library drug
definitions.delta_emax: Bliss-expected Emax minus observed combo Emax (viability units 0-1; positive = more kill than Bliss)
definitions.delta_xmid_log2: library IC50 shift caused by anchor (library Xmid - combo Xmid) on log2 scale; 3 = 8-fold
definitions.synergy: file flag; Jaaks 2022 rule is dXmid >= 3 or dEmax >= 0.2 at either anchor concentration. Agreement of file flag with this rule over all rows: 0.9639
definitions.per_line: a line counts as synergistic if any anchor conc / orientation row is flagged
definitions.genotype_groups: from Cell Model Passports mutations (see gdsc_targets.json flag_definitions)
